title: Premium Payment Application on the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Account
content:
> A payment on a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is applied oldest charge first and recorded with its confirmation or check number exactly as issued.

## The premium account

The umbrella's premium balance is the umbrella premium and fees the named insured owes. A positive balance is owed to the company; a negative balance is a credit to the named insured. Installments billed, fees charged, additional premium for an added exposure and refunds issued raise the balance; payments received and return premium credited lower it.

## Applying a payment

A payment is applied to the oldest outstanding charge on the umbrella's premium account first, and only then to the next oldest, and so on.

*Hypothetical:* the account carries an installment of $42.00 billed first and a late fee of $10.00 charged later, and a payment of $50.00 is received. The first $42.00 is applied to the installment and the remaining $8.00 to the late fee, leaving $2.00 of the fee unpaid.

## Recording a payment

The payment is recorded with its confirmation number or check number exactly as issued, character for character.

*Hypothetical:* a check numbered 004517 is recorded as 004517, not as 4517.
